rationale: The original entry thesis relied on price holding above the 5-minute 9-EMA ($100.58) after an upward inflection, which has immediately failed as five consecutive 1-minute candles made lower highs and lower closes down to $100.17. With the bid currently at $100.10 (below the $100.14 invalidation) and a wide 15.0 bps spread ($100.10 x $100.25), initiating a close now allows us to work out of the position passively or inside the spread rather than waiting a few ticks to get crossed at the bid via the automatic stop.
